name: The Befouled Element
summary: Around Mystral Lake, you find glowing globes of tainted water among the slain elementals. You carry a specimen to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post to learn what has poisoned the lake and its spirits.

sections.title: Tainted Waters of Mystral Lake
sections.body: Mystral Lake lies in south-central Ashenvale, and its water elementals have grown violently aggressive and visibly corrupted. When slain, they leave strange, intensely glowing spheres of putrid fluid instead of pure elemental essence. The globes hold the corruption that has settled over the lake, showing that something more than natural territorial aggression is at work.

sections.title: Seeking Splintertree's Counsel
sections.body: Horde scouts seek guidance at Splintertree Post, where Mastok Wrilehiss oversees the outpost. He is disgusted by the vile specimen. A soldier rather than a scholar, Mastok knows mundane steel cannot cure diseased water, so he points you toward the elemental specialists of the Earthen Ring.

faq.q: What is inside the Befouled Water Globe?
aliases: what is in the water globe
faq.answer: The Befouled Water Globe holds a disgusting, concentrated sample of the corruption poisoning Mystral Lake. It forms from slain elementals, showing that their spiritual corruption has taken physical and potent form.

aliases: where do i find the water globe
how to start the befouled element
faq.answer: You find the globe while fighting enraged or befouled water elementals at Mystral Lake in south-central Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Mastok Wrilehiss want nothing to do with it?
faq.answer: Mastok Wrilehiss is a Horde officer focused on military survival and logistics at Splintertree Post. He has no affinity for diagnosing diseased magical waters, so he points you toward the Earthen Ring.

faq.q: What is the Earthen Ring's interest in this?
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring is an order of shamans devoted to studying, soothing, and restoring harmony to the elements. Corrupted elementals like those at Mystral Lake fall under their spiritual care.

faq.q: Where does the investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Mastok points you toward Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring shaman stationed along Ashenvale's western shore at Zoram'gar Strand. Je'neu can examine the tainted relic.

angles.text: As a shaman, you hear the pain in Mystral Lake's twisted spirits and know the Earthen Ring must intervene.
As a member of the Horde, you know Splintertree Post cannot let an elemental menace threaten its backyard while Alliance sentinels and furbolgs menace Horde supply routes.
As a tauren, you feel a deep cultural duty to heal the land's corrupted waters, making Mystral Lake's restoration an urgent spiritual task.
